candidate_sentence_map.S1: Ambu A/S reported a solid start to the 2025/26 financial year, characterized by continued strong growth momentum in its Endoscopy Solutions segment.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Total revenue increased organically by 8.6% to DKK 1,558 million, compared to DKK 1,510 million in the same quarter of the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: On a reported basis, revenue growth was 3.2%, negatively impacted by foreign exchange headwinds of 5.4%.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: The Endoscopy Solutions business group, which accounted for 63% of total revenue, delivered robust organic growth of 14.4%, driven primarily by the Urology, ENT, & GI group, which grew by 21.0%.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: This growth was fueled by the continued penetration of the aScope 4 portfolio and strong momentum for the newly launched aScope 5 Uretero.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: The Respiratory business group also contributed to this success with 8.3% organic growth, supported by the adoption of aScope 5 Broncho and the recent launch of the SureSight Mobile video laryngoscope.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: In contrast, the Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring segment posted flat organic growth of -0.1%, reflecting an extraordinarily high revenue baseline in the prior year period.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Geographically, North America and Europe both contributed positively with organic growth of 9.8% and 9.7%, respectively, while the Rest of World region declined by 1.6% due to order fluctuations and high comparables.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Profitability metrics showed pressure from external factors.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: EBIT before special items amounted to DKK 164 million, down from DKK 243 million in Q1 2024/25, resulting in an EBIT margin of 10.5%, a decrease of 5.6 percentage points.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: The report notes that this margin was negatively impacted by tariff costs exceeding DKK 50 million and foreign exchange headwinds.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: However, adjusting for these external factors, the underlying EBIT margin was 15.2%, demonstrating continued operational leverage from organic growth.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Operating expenses to revenue increased to 50.3% from 45.2% in the prior year, partly due to the inclusion of tariff costs and ongoing investments in commercial infrastructure to drive future growth.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Gross margin declined slightly to 60.8% from 61.3%, primarily due to the high comparable gross margin in the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Cash flow performance was impacted by working capital changes and external costs.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Free cash flow before acquisitions totaled DKK 13 million, down from DKK 69 million in the prior year.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: This decline was mainly driven by an increase in net working capital, which remained elevated to mitigate global geopolitical uncertainties and support growth.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Cash flow from operating activities was DKK 106 million, compared to DKK 144 million previously.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: The company maintained its financial guidance for the full year, expecting organic revenue growth of 10-13% and an EBIT margin before special items of 12-14%.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: Ambu also announced the initiation of a share buyback program with DKK 38 million spent on treasury shares in Q1 and paid a dividend of DKK 90 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: The company’s net interest-bearing debt stood at a net cash position of DKK 178 million, indicating a strong balance sheet despite the temporary headwinds.
candidate_sentence_map.S22: Overall, Ambu demonstrated resilience and strategic execution, with the Endoscopy Solutions segment continuing to be the primary engine for growth, while management remains committed to long-term investments and sustainability initiatives, including the expansion of its recycling program.
